title: This Is My Neighborhood — VOA Lesson 11
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 1 Lesson 11. Original VOA conversation audio and dialogue. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA. Sentence cues are machine-aligned from the original VOA audio and are provisional pending listening review.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Hello! DC is a city for walking. In our neighborhood, I can do all my errands. Marsha, before we get ice cream, I need to return three books to the library. Where is the library?
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا! واشنطن مدينة مناسبة للمشي. يمكنني إنجاز كل مشاويري في حيّنا. مارشا، قبل أن نشتري المثلجات يجب أن أعيد ثلاثة كتب للمكتبة. أين هي؟

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: It is on this street on the corner.
dialogue.translation_ar: تقع في هذا الشارع عند الزاوية.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Awesome!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Let's go!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Marsha, I can return the books here.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Anna, what are those in the books?
dialogue.translation_ar: آنا، ما هذه الأشياء داخل الكتب؟

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Marsha, these are letters to my family and friends back home … four letters! Is there a post office near here?
dialogue.translation_ar: مارشا، هذه رسائل إلى عائلتي وأصدقائي في بلدتي... أربع رسائل! هل يوجد مكتب بريد قريب؟

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Um, no. The post office is far from here. But there is a mailbox across from the store.
dialogue.translation_ar: لا، مكتب البريد بعيد، لكن هناك صندوق بريد مقابل المتجر.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Awesome! Let’s go!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Marsha, now I need to buy stamps.
dialogue.translation_ar: مارشا، الآن أحتاج إلى شراء طوابع.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Do you have cash?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: No. Is there a bank near here?

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: There is a bank behind you.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Thanks, Marsha. You know our neighborhood so well.
dialogue.translation_ar: شكرًا يا مارشا. أنت تعرفين حيّنا جيدًا.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Now I have cash. I can buy stamps.
dialogue.translation_ar: الآن معي نقود ويمكنني شراء الطوابع.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: That store sells stamps.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Wait here.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I have stamps.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Wow, you’re fast.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Thank you, thank you letters, for sending my words… my love … to my family and friends -
dialogue.translation_ar: شكرًا لك أيتها الرسائل، لأنك تحملين كلماتي... وحبي... إلى عائلتي وأصدقائي...

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Do you have more cash?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I do!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha and Anna
dialogue.text: Ice cream!!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I love my new neighborhood! Everything is near our apartment! Even hair salons, and ice cream!
dialogue.translation_ar: أحب حيي الجديد! كل شيء قريب من شقتنا، حتى صالونات الشعر والمثلجات!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Until next time!
